title: Ukrainian Leaf Wraps
description: A simple Ukrainian-inspired dish made with fresh leafy greens wrapped in a crispy aerated wrap.

ingredients.name: Fresh Leafy Greens
ingredients.notes: Choose your favorite type of leafy green

ingredients.name: Aerated Wrap
ingredients.notes: Can be substituted with a traditional wrap

ingredients.name: Ukrainian Feta Cheese
ingredients.notes: Can be substituted with regular feta cheese

instructions: Preheat a pan over medium heat.
Add the wilted spinach and garlic mixture and stir to combine.
Add the Ukrainian feta cheese and stir to combine.
Place an aerated wrap on a flat surface.
Add a handful of fresh leafy greens to the center of the wrap.
Spoon the spinach and feta mixture on top of the greens.
Fold the bottom half of the wrap up over the filling.
Fold in the sides and roll the wrap up tightly.
